urls.rationale: Sec. 24.45.011 Purpose - legislative declaration framing the lobbying-disclosure regime.
Sec. 24.45.021 Administration - administering authority for the lobbying-disclosure statute.
Sec. 24.45.031 Powers and duties - administering authority's powers and duties under the lobbying-disclosure statute.
Sec. 24.45.041 Registration; disqualification - core lobbyist registration provision.
Sec. 24.45.051 Reports - core lobbyist activity/expenditure reporting provision.
Sec. 24.45.061 Reports by employers of lobbyists - employer-side reporting obligation.
Sec. 24.45.071 Certification of reports - certification requirement for filed reports.
Sec. 24.45.081 Reporting periods - reporting period specification for lobbyist disclosures.
Sec. 24.45.091 Publication of reports - publication rules for disclosed reports.
Sec. 24.45.101 Public records - public-records status of disclosed reports.
Sec. 24.45.111 Preservation of records - record-retention requirement for lobbyist disclosures.
Sec. 24.45.116 Disclosure of contributions - lobbyist contribution disclosure obligation.
Sec. 24.45.121 Prohibitions - prohibited lobbyist conduct.
Sec. 24.45.131 Examination of statements, reports - enforcement examination of filed disclosures.
Sec. 24.45.135 Administrative complaints - administrative complaint procedure for disclosure violations.
Sec. 24.45.141 Civil penalty: Late registration, filing of required statements or reports - civil penalty for late disclosure filings.
Sec. 24.45.151 Criminal penalties - criminal penalties for disclosure violations.
Sec. 24.45.161 Exemptions - exemptions from the lobbying-disclosure regime.
Sec. 24.45.171 Definitions - definitions used throughout the lobbying-disclosure chapter.
Sec. 24.45.181 Short title - short title for the Regulation of Lobbying Act.
